specialities.name: Hyderabadi Dum Biryani
specialities.why: Slow-cooked to perfection with succulent meat, fragrant basmati rice, and rich spices using the traditional dum method.

specialities.name: Qubani Ka Meetha
specialities.why: A classic Hyderabadi wedding dessert made from stewed apricots, traditionally served warm with fresh cream or vanilla ice cream.

specialities.name: Irani Chai and Osmania Biscuit
specialities.why: The quintessential Hyderabadi cafe culture pairing of strong, milky tea with buttery, slightly salty biscuits.

specialities.name: Hyderabad Pearls
specialities.why: Hyderabad is globally renowned as the City of Pearls, famous for its centuries-old tradition of drilling, polishing, and stringing high-quality freshwater and saltwater pearls.

specialities.name: Bidriware
specialities.why: A unique metal handicraft from the region featuring striking dark-alloy art inlaid with pure silver wire.

specialities.name: Explore Golconda Fort
specialities.why: A majestic medieval fortress famous for its acoustic marvels, where a handclap at the entrance gate can be heard at the hilltop pavilion.
